area.sourceLabel: YRT On-Request pages and service-area shapefiles (agency-supplied)

Aurora GO.serviceHours: Monday to Friday 5:30 to 9:30 a.m. and 4 to 8 p.m.
Aurora GO.tripRules: Trips must start or end at Aurora GO Station (platform 5).

Kleinburg-Nashville.serviceHours: Monday to Friday 5:30 a.m. to 8 p.m.
Kleinburg-Nashville.tripRules: Trips can start and end anywhere in the Kleinburg-Nashville zone.

Maple-Rutherford GO.serviceHours: Monday to Friday 6 to 9 a.m. and 3:30 to 6:30 p.m.
Maple-Rutherford GO.tripRules: Trips must start or end at Rutherford or Maple GO Station.

Markham.serviceHours: Monday to Friday 6 a.m. to 8 p.m.
Markham.tripRules: Trips can start and end anywhere in the Markham zone.

North-Central.serviceHours: Monday to Friday 5:30 a.m. to 11 p.m.; Saturday 8 a.m. to 11 p.m.; Sunday and holidays 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.
North-Central.tripRules: Trips can start and end anywhere in the North-Central zone.

Richmond Hill Local.serviceHours: Monday to Friday 7 a.m. to 3 p.m.
Richmond Hill Local.tripRules: Trips must start or end at one of nine listed places, such as Mon Sheong Court, 33 Weldrick Road East or 100 Observatory Lane.

Stouffville.serviceHours: Monday to Friday 5:30 a.m. to 11 p.m.; Saturday 8 a.m. to 11 p.m.; Sunday and holidays 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.
Stouffville.tripRules: Trips can start and end anywhere in the Stouffville zone.

Woodbridge.serviceHours: Monday to Friday 10 a.m. to 2 p.m.; weekends and holidays 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.
Woodbridge.tripRules: Trips can start and end anywhere in the Woodbridge zone.

notes: Zones from the eight shapefiles York Region Transit sent Atlas in November 2026 (CIV-2210, 'RE: YRT On-Request service area GIS files'; saved unchanged in _reports/agency-files/yrt/), reprojected from NAD83 / UTM zone 17N to WGS84 at 7 decimals. North-Central (70,341 vertices) is simplified at 5 m, leaving 2,005 vertices and its area unchanged (904.56 km2); the other seven are as sent. Repeated points left by rounding to 7 decimals are removed (7). Hours, booking and trip rules from each area's page on yrt.ca, 2026-11-24. YRT's 65+ service (trips within 5 km for riders 65 and older) has no shapefile and is not drawn. Atlas drew no YRT zones before; YRT was listed as on-demand not yet mapped.
